applies_to: Public & private controllers and processors established in North Macedonia
key_requirements: GDPR-style lawful basis & consent, data subject rights, DPO, direct marketing only with consent
retention_period: No longer than necessary for the purpose
penalties_range: Up to 4% of annual turnover (2% for lesser breaches)
deceased_data: Personal data of deceased persons listed among categories given heightened protection under LPDP; duration and article not confirmed (unconfirmed)
genetic_data: Defined (art. 4(13)) and treated as special category; processing prohibited unless an exception applies (GDPR-aligned)
notes: Replaced 2005 law; GDPR-modelled; in force 24 Feb 2020; full application 24 Aug 2021
